what: MESH step 2, run live on the forge page itself: two devices pair by a hand-pasted invite and reply, each proves the key its invite named on THIS link, and cards travel straight across a WebRTC DataChannel. The receiver re-checks every card with the same judgement the reader makes and shows nothing that fails.
honest_scope: Two independent browser identities on ONE machine (http://localhost:8160 and http://127.0.0.1:8160 — different origins, so separate storage and separate non-extractable Ed25519 keys). A recorded observation, not a regenerable receipt: browser keys, certificates and link codes are random. The decisions are made by trade.mjs, which CI mutation-gates. The two-DEVICE run waits on a second device.

deviceA.note: planted in the OLD format (an exportable private key in localStorage); the page moved it into IndexedDB as non-extractable on first use — same public key, exportKey now throws InvalidAccessError, the localStorage copy deleted

topology.link: RTCPeerConnection DataChannel; invite + reply pasted by hand (fall-os webrtc.mjs, fall-federate invite check, both vendored and inlined)
topology.stun: none — the STUN box was unticked on both devices; no third party at all

proof_of_key.how: on open, each device sends a fresh 16-byte challenge; the other signs 'fallkard-forge trade hello v1|nonce|its key|the asker's key|its certificate fingerprint|the asker's certificate fingerprint'. A third device relaying the challenge between two pairings cannot present the prover's certificate on its own link, so a relayed proof does not verify (the adversarial review found the key-only version could be relayed).

cases.sent: A → B: a card A just forged (68472 bytes, 8 parts)
cases.tier: uncommon (re-derived from the build on B)
cases.shown: picture + facts; added to B's deck

cases.sent: A → B: the same picture and manifest carrying a different build (68376 bytes)
cases.reason: the build inside is not the build that was sealed — refused, nothing shown
cases.shown: the refusal only — no picture, no build

cases.sent: B → A: the card B received, opened in B's reader, sent back
cases.reason: signed by a key other than the one the sender named: a card it holds, passed on

cases.sent: A → B: an unsigned card with an honest seal and a konomi-artifact bundle whose tier is an payload
cases.opened_in_reader: the payload shows as text; no script ran (window flag stayed 0; no element injected)

cases.result: B said 'the other device is gone' 5 s later and disabled Send

the_script_injection_fixed.before: the then-live page (commit cad1539), served locally: dropping the hostile card into the reader RAN its payload (window flag 1, one injected element)
the_script_injection_fixed.after: this page: the same card, dropped in and received over the link, runs nothing (flag 0, no element); the check text is escaped
the_script_injection_fixed.found_by: the adversarial review of this change; the hole predates the trade (studio commit 77e2594) but the trade put it one click from a remote peer

never_ran_the_build: opening a received card only reads it; the only iframe on the page is the studio's own preview (hidden, empty)
network: each device requested only its own page (a single file) plus local blob: URLs for the pictures. Zero requests left the machine.
phone_width: 375px: no element wider than the screen
